description:
Reload MCP server connections from mcp_servers.json and report the result.
- Reconnects added or changed servers, drops removed/disabled ones, and keeps healthy ones
- The report doubles as a connection test: per server it shows connected/failed, the error (including the server's stderr) on failure, and the wire names of every available tool
- Call this after editing %APPDATA%/locus/mcp_servers.json so the new tools become callable in this conversation (they are named mcp__<server>__<tool>)
- Follow the guidance in the connect-software skill (skill/builtin/connect-software.md) when adding or fixing server configs
